meta_description: Astounding Grounds Ltd in Manchester offers expert garden design, maintenance and landscaping. Local gardeners serving M20 and beyond. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Gardeners — Transform Your Outdoor Space
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden redesigns, we bring your outdoor space to life with expert care and attention to detail.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance, a full redesign, or specialist landscaping, we've got every aspect of garden care covered.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly lawn cuts, hedge trimming, weeding and seasonal planting. We keep your garden looking pristine all year round, with flexible scheduling to suit your diary.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden redesigns that transform neglected outdoor spaces. From patio installations to raised beds and water features, we create gardens tailored to your lifestyle and budget.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatment
services.desc: Professional lawn feeding, aeration and moss control to restore patchy grass to thick, healthy turf. We diagnose problems and deliver visible results within weeks.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning and shaping of trees, shrubs and specimen plants. We improve structure, health and aesthetics whilst ensuring safe clearance from buildings and fences.

services.title: Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Reclaim overgrown gardens with our thorough clearance service. We remove dead wood, undergrowth and rubble, leaving a blank canvas ready for planting or development.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Beds
services.desc: Vibrant seasonal colour schemes and perennial planting schemes designed for low maintenance and year-round interest. We source quality plants and ensure proper establishment care.

about_pullquote: We believe every garden should be a place you actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: Astounding Grounds Ltd was founded on a simple idea: that a well-maintained garden should be accessible to everyone, not just those with unlimited budgets. Over fifteen years, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, reliable service, and genuine expertise across Manchester's neighbourhoods. Our team combines hands-on experience with real passion for plants and outdoor design.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we listen before we dig. Whether you need a weekly tidy-up or a complete garden overhaul, we treat your outdoor space with the care it deserves. Repeat bookings are the backbone of our business — the sign that we've genuinely earned your trust.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service. My garden was completely out of control after two years of neglect, and I honestly thought it would cost a fortune to sort. James and the team came out, gave me a realistic quote, and got stuck in. It looks amazing now. Really professional, fair prices, and they even gave me advice on keeping it maintained. Will be booking them in monthly.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had them do a complete redesign including new patio and raised veg beds. They were punctual, tidy, and actually listened to what I wanted rather than just pushing their own ideas. Finished on time and within budget. Can't ask for much more than that.
reviews.author: Rachel M.

reviews.text: Been using Astounding Grounds for three years now. They come every other week, know exactly what they're doing with the lawn and borders, and always leave the garden looking immaculate. Very reliable and reasonably priced. Couldn't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

address_sub: Serving all of Greater Manchester, including Didsbury, Withington, Stockport, Altrincham and surrounding areas.
opening_hours_sub: Sat: 9am – 5pm • Quote requests answered within 48 hours
emergency_banner_text: Need your garden transformed urgently? We can often fit emergency clearances and rescue projects within a week. Get in touch —
